The '''shopping mall vendor''' is a [[Protectron (Fallout 76)|Protectron]] operating at [[the Whitespring Resort]] in [[Appalachia]]. 

==Background==
The shopping mall vendor is one of the robotic vendors the Whitespring Resort replaced their human staff with shortly before the [[Great War]].<ref>[[The Whitespring 2080 Initiative]]</ref> It is found in the Whitespring Resort's Aurum along with [[Helena (Fallout 76)|Helena]]. It sells a variety of items, including plans and other wares alongside other faction vendors.

'''Camden Park security''' is a unique [[Protectron (Fallout 76)|Protectron]] found at [[Camden Park]] {{in|FO76}}.     

==Background==
This Protectron guards the staff area of Camden Park. It is operational even though its head has been mostly destroyed, and appears to have issues with its sensors, mistaking passers-by for park employees.

'''Cunningham''' is a [[Mister Handy (Fallout 76)|Mister Handy]] serving as a [[Fallout 76 vendors|vendor]] at [[the Whitespring Resort]] in [[Appalachia]].            

==Background==
Cunningham is a Mr. Handy, and one of the dozen or so robotic vendors the Whitespring Resort replaced their human staff with shortly before the [[Great War]].<ref>[[The Whitespring 2080 Initiative]]</ref> He resides in the Creekside Lodge store of the Whitespring mall area and is mainly responsible for selling armors and weapons to the player character.
